description: This file is a smoke test for the /api/dashboard/overview/metrics API endpoint. It uses the supertest library to send HTTP requests directly to an Express application to verify the endpoint responds correctly or gracefully handles unavailability scenarios. The test checks for proper response status codes and validates the structure of the response body when available.
